seo.title: The Tool Bank
seo.description: Borrow tools instead of buying them — free for CCD resident members.

hero.title: Borrow it.
hero.body: The CCD Tool Bank lets resident members borrow tools for home repairs, garden work, and block projects — making ownership cheaper and collective.
hero.alt: Young gardener with gloves, wheelbarrow, and trowel at the community beds

steps.title: Become a member
steps.body: Resident members get free Tool Bank access; others get discounted access.

steps.title: Reserve a tool
steps.body: Request the tool you need for your home, garden, or block project.

steps.title: Pick up & return
steps.body: Grab it, do the work, and return it for the next neighbor.

sections.title: Made for real neighborhood work.
sections.body: From lawn and garden equipment to basic home-repair tools, the Tool Bank is built around neighbor-to-neighbor repair. Full tool inventory is being catalogued — reach out and we'll tell you what's available.
sections.alt: CCD work truck loaded with rakes and tools on a job site

sections.title: Free for resident members.
sections.body: Join CCD as a resident member for free Tool Bank access and a vote in the co-op.
sections.label: Become a member
